finance-build.description: Implement and validate routine PowerShell, Python, Databricks, and Power BI finance workflows

finance-deep.description: Investigate difficult schema drift, reconciliation mismatches, metadata boundaries, and cross-system failures

validate.description: Run the repository checks and summarize evidence
validate.template: Load the finance-data-reliability skill. Run the smallest relevant tests, then the full available suite. Report commands, exit codes, receipts, failures, and anything that was not validated. Do not claim success from inspection alone.

diagnose-run.description: Classify a failed spool or reconciliation run
diagnose-run.template: Load the finance-data-reliability skill and its failure taxonomy. Diagnose $ARGUMENTS from receipts and sanitized logs. Separate evidence from inference, classify retryability, and propose the smallest safe next action. Do not modify source data or production systems.

pbi-capabilities.description: Inventory one Power BI workspace semantic model and choose REST, XMLA, MCP, or Desktop without mutation
pbi-capabilities.template: Load the finance-data-reliability skill, references/power-bi-boundaries.md, and references/power-bi-premium-workspace-runbook.md. For $ARGUMENTS, perform only the read-only capability inventory using the existing approved authenticated adapter. Never request, print, persist, decode, or accept a bearer token. Return sanitized target identity, observed capacity assignment, REST, XMLA, and MCP capabilities, permission and settings evidence, recommended route, missing prerequisites, and unsupported assumptions. Do not trigger or cancel refresh, refresh permissions, take ownership, rebind a report, change schedules or parameters, commit an MCP transaction, apply service TMDL, call Fabric updateDefinition, save or deploy metadata, or modify any service object.

dbx-capabilities.description: Inventory bounded Databricks metadata through one approved named profile without SQL or mutation
dbx-capabilities.template: Load the finance-data-reliability skill and references/databricks-agent-access.md. For $ARGUMENTS, use only an existing approved authenticated adapter and fixed private aliases. If the adapter, explicit named profile, allowlist, or target alias is unavailable, fail closed with MISSING_PREREQUISITE; do not install software or fall back to raw REST, a token, or an arbitrary shell command. Permit only a projected current-identity confirmation, accessible warehouse states, one bounded nonrecursive approved workspace path, and allowlisted Unity Catalog metadata. Return aliases, counts, capability booleans, versions, and sanitized error classes only. Never request, print, persist, decode, export, or accept a bearer token, PAT, profile contents, hostname, raw ID, owner, email, storage location, JDBC URL, source code, comment, query text, or row. Do not run SQL, start or stop compute, export or run a notebook, run or cancel a job, recurse from a workspace/catalog root, change grants, install packages, or modify any Databricks object.

dbx-genie-probe.description: Ask one allowlisted Genie Agent question and return an explicitly unverified, bounded hypothesis package
dbx-genie-probe.template: Load the finance-data-reliability skill, references/databricks-agent-access.md, and references/databricks-reconciliation.md. For $ARGUMENTS, require an approved profile_alias, space_alias, question_template, deadline, poll bound, result row/byte caps, and optional deterministic check_id. This invocation authorizes one task-scoped Genie interaction, conversation state, and its associated read query/warehouse compute only; disclose those side effects before execution. Resolve raw workspace/space/message IDs privately, start a new task conversation, poll the same message with bounded backoff, and return only aliases, terminal state, elapsed time, generated-SQL hash, trusted-asset indicator, truncation flag, approved source aliases, and the required check. Never return or accept tokens, raw IDs/hosts, prompts, instructions, generated SQL text, rows, signed links, other users' conversations, or full attachments. Do not use the broad Databricks SQL MCP for verification, delete or update Genie state, mutate workspace/catalog/data, retry a lost POST blindly, or claim VERIFIED. The terminal conclusion must remain UNVERIFIED_HYPOTHESIS until a separate deterministic reconciliation passes.
